description: Validate JSON data against a JSON Schema (drafts 2020-12, 2019-09, 7 and 4) and list each error with its data path and schema keyword. Operations: "validate" — Validate JSON data against a JSON Schema.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

operation.description: validate — Validate JSON data against a JSON Schema.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

draft.description: Schema draft. "auto" reads $schema and falls back to 2020-12. Used by: validate.

schema.description: The JSON Schema, as JSON text. Self-contained: $ref may point inside it ($defs, definitions) but remote schemas are not fetched. Used by: validate. Required by: validate.

name: json-schema-validator
title: JSON Schema Validator
